description: This file defines the SugarCronRemoteJobs class, a subclass of SugarCronJobs, which facilitates executing scheduled jobs remotely via REST API calls to a specified job server. It handles setup of the REST client, constructs requests to submit jobs, and manages job execution responses and failures.

classes.name: SugarCronRemoteJobs
classes.description: A CRON driver for job queue that schedules and executes jobs remotely through HTTP REST calls. It extends the SugarCronJobs class to override job execution by delegating work to a remote server.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarCronRemoteJobs object, setting the remote job server URL from configuration and initializing the REST client.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Sets the REST client used to communicate with the remote job server.

methods.name: getMyId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this client instance, used to tag job requests.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Executes a given scheduled job by sending a request to the remote server and handles the response, marking the job as failed if the server does not accept it or if communication fails.
